note: Every file in e2e/tests is in exactly one group (scripts/release-check.test.mjs checks it). Run from code/. Spec arguments after run.mjs are Playwright file filters; --full also builds the desktop app and includes the @slow tests.

extension.description: Chromium with the built test extension against the in-process server and the fake engine; includes hostile.spec.ts, which needs no browser.

desktop.description: Electron app (@slow tests): shell, library and reader against the built desktop app.

slow.description: Real Kokoro model from code/.cache/models; not run on hosted runners.

perf.description: Absolute budgets on a quiet machine, one worker; includes the real-model lifecycle test. Run through the release gate, which writes docs/perf-runs/<version>.json.
